steps.text: I counted them on three portals from late February to mid June 2026.

steps.text: {{h02-blocks.tech_ads}} technical job ads remain, that is {{h02-blocks.tech_share_raw}} of {{h02-blocks.raw_ads}}. An ad is not a hire.

steps.label: Second way of counting
steps.text: Counting copies in the same place once leaves {{h02-blocks.tech_ads_same_place}} ads. Whether one job in two places is one role, no ad says.
steps.claim: Between {{h02-blocks.tech_low}} and {{h02-blocks.tech_high}} of 100 are technical job ads.
